/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
plugin = pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-advisory-4b694214/kk/0.23.0')
bundle = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='kk-review-evidence-'))
base = subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
files = ['README.md','reader.py','preferences.py','repository.py','tests/test_reads.py']
criteria = [str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/p) for p in ['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']]
criteria += [str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/p) for p in ['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']]
assert len(criteria)==8 and all(pathlib.Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
records=[]
for version, rev in [('candidate',':'),('historical',base+':')]:
    for name in files:
        blob = subprocess.check_output(['git','show',rev+name])
        target = bundle/version/name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(blob)
        target.chmod(0o444)
        records.append({'category':version,'repository':str(root),'revision':base if version=='historical' else 'staged index over '+base,'original_path':name,'path':str(target),'git_blob':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',rev+name],text=True).strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),'original_lines':[1,len(blob.splitlines())],'omitted_or_redacted':'none'})
diff=bundle/'staged.patch'
diff.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--no-ext-diff','--binary']))
context=bundle/'context.md'
context.write_text('''# Review context
User requests isolated review of staged preference ID normalization; review-only.
Selector: git diff --cached; base HEAD {base}. Candidate is staged index; no unstaged changes at capture. Two changed files: reader.py (+1/-1), tests/test_reads.py (+20/-3).
Explicit contract: candidate README.md says trim surrounding whitespace before lookup, preserve resilient reads: up to three attempts on TransientRead, return first success, propagate exhausted TransientRead, propagate permanent MissingPreference on first attempt; reads have no side effects. Preferences.read is public entry; Repository.read_resilient owns retries, read_once performs one attempt.
Task Scope: No task scope available — review diff on its own merits without assuming feature-level design docs.
Compatibility baseline: local HEAD {base}; no named release/deployment baseline or deployment configuration present. Standard-library Python 3.9+ code; no schema, persistence mutation or release prerequisites declared.
Affected chain: Preferences.read -> reader.read_preferences -> Repository.read_resilient -> Repository.read_once -> ScriptedBackend.read.
Evidence: full staged and HEAD snapshots of all five repository files supplied, plus selected diff and provenance. No tests have been run yet at bundle creation. Prior-findings and Python idiom Capy searches returned empty knowledge base.
Rejected approaches: none supplied.
Apply all eight criteria files before reviewing evidence. Python activated by .py extension on both changed files; all four Python checklist files always load, with no conditionals. Other seven known profiles did not match.
Independently inspect the evidence and challenge inferences. Request specific missing source by repository/revision/path or symbol and comparison. Do not assume source-only review proves execution. PAL tool unavailable in current session; no second reviewer conclusions exist.
'''.format(base=base))
manifest={'selector':'git diff --cached','base':base,'instructions':criteria,'diff':str(diff),'intent_context':str(context),'source_evidence':records}
manifest_path=bundle/'manifest.json'
manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
for p in [diff,context,manifest_path]: p.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({'bundle':str(bundle),'manifest':str(manifest_path),'criteria_count':len(criteria),'base':base},indent=2))
PY"
